First, note the given date: 12-24-1584 (MM-DD-YYYY).  
Subtract 43 weeks and 4 days:  
43 weeks = 43 × 7 = 301 days.  
Plus 4 days = 305 days total to subtract.  

1584 is a leap year (divisible by 4, not by 100).  
Dec 24, 1584 minus 305 days:  
Go back 24 days to Dec 1, 1584 → 281 days left.  
Nov has 30 days → back to Nov 1 → 251 days left.  
Oct has 31 days → back to Oct 1 → 220 days left.  
Sep 30 days → Sep 1 → 190 days left.  
Aug 31 days → Aug 1 → 159 days left.  
Jul 31 days → Jul 1 → 128 days left.  
Jun 30 days → Jun 1 → 98 days left.  
May 31 days → May 1 → 67 days left.  
Apr 30 days → Apr 1 → 37 days left.  
Mar 31 days → Mar 1 → 6 days left.  
Feb has 29 days (leap year) → go back 6 days from Mar 1 → Feb 24, 1584.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1584-02-24
